mapper.insert: insert into position_apply (position_id, student_id, semester_id, apply_remark, status, reject_reason, audit_time, audit_user, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{positionId}, #{studentId}, #{semesterId}, #{applyRemark}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, #{auditTime}, #{auditUser}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update position_apply set semester_id = #{semesterId}, apply_remark = #{applyRemark}, status = #{status}, reject_reason = null, audit_time = null, audit_user = null, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} where id = #{id}
